en.name: Instagram comment to DM: leads in Google Sheets
en.description: When someone comments a keyword such as PRICE under your post or reel, they get a private message from you at once, a public reply so others see you answered, and a row in your Google Sheet with their user name, comment and the post. Set up: put the Verify Token and App Secret on the Instagram Trigger and subscribe your Meta app's Instagram webhook to comments; change the keywords on the trigger; pick your Instagram credential on both Instagram nodes and write your own message; pick a Google credential and your sheet on Google Sheets (columns: Date, User name, User ID, Comment, Post).
en.dmMessage: Hi {{instagram.fromName}}, thanks for your comment! Here are the prices and details (replace with your own): ... Reply to this message with any question and we will help you.
en.publicReply: Thanks! We have sent you a DM with the details.
